speaker: penny
text: Wow, Sheldon, I cannot believe you made up your own game.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, Research Lab is more than a game. It's like the slogan says, the physics is theoretical, but the fun is real.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: We must not be playing it right.

speaker: penny
text: All right, five. One, two, three, four, five. Oh, wow, look at that, my Department of Defence research grant is renewed.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh! Great roll! Now you can demolish your Soviet-style cyclotron and build the large Hadron Collider.

speaker: penny
text: Yay.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're a natural at this, Penny. And as the first beta testers, you two'll have quite the edge when we play with Wolowitz and Koothrappali on Sunday.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, gee, Sheldon, I don't think we can play on Sunday.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Why not?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Because of the reasons that Penny will now tell you. Penny?

speaker: penny
text: Actually, I have to pick up my friend Justin from the airport.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: There you go, she has to pick up her friend Justin at the airport, aAnd I can't play'cause I'm going with her, right?

speaker: penny
text: Um, yeah, if you want. I mean, there may not be room. He's got a lot of stuff, like guitars and amplifiers.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Wait. What are you talking about?

speaker: penny
text: My friend, Justin.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Pay attention, Leonard. That's why she can't play on Sunday.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Who is this Justin? No, you didn't.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Your turn, Leonard. Roll the dice, Leonard.

speaker: penny
text: I told you about him.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, my friend from Omaha, plays the guitar. Anyway, he's coming to L.A. looking for some session work, so I told him he could just crash on my couch for a few weeks.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Come on, Leonard, if you roll a six, Penny dies horribly in a nuclear meltdown. See what I mean when I say the fun is real?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hang on. Some guy is going to be sleeping on your couch?

speaker: penny
text: He's not some guy. He's my friend.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So by friend, do you mean friend friend, gay friend, or ex boyfriend who you're now platonic with but still might have a thing for you friend"?

speaker: penny
text: Well, he's definitely not gay.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, a definitely not gay musician sleeping on my girlfriend's couch. Yippee.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, we went out a little bit, a long time ago, but we were never like going out.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, not to be pedantic, but the last I checked went out was in fact the past tense of going out, which I think we all know is a popular euphemism for saw each other naked.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'll just roll for you.

speaker: penny
text: Do you have a problem with Justin staying with me?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What was your first clue?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Uh-oh! Industrial accident.

speaker: penny
text: You know what? Don't talk to me like I'm an idiot.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm not talking to you like you're an idiot! I'm saying the whole idea is idiotic!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You accidentally stare at a helium-argon laser. Lose one turn and a retina.

speaker: penny
text: How is that not talking to me like I'm an idiot? It's my friend, it's my couch, and it's my freakin' life!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It's also your roll.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You know what? It is your life. If you want to have some stupid guitarist stay on your couch, then fine. Why don't you just rent some bunk beds and invite The Black Eyed Peas?

speaker: penny
text: Hey, if I want to invite the entire line up of Lollapalooza to sleep in my apartment, I will, and it's none of your business!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Are you listening to yourself? Do you know how childish you sound right now?

speaker: penny
text: Oh, now I'm a child? Well, at least I'm not an idiot anymore!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: The two aren't mutually exclusive!

speaker: penny
text: Oh, you are such a... What the hell is he doing?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: He's drowning us out. He doesn't like fighting.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, just stop, look, the fight is over. Oh, and FYI, you never even heard of The Black Eyed Peas until you met me!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I heard of'em. Didn't know they were a band. Sheldon, she's gone. You can turn off the blender.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Has your relationship reached its inevitable ugly end?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, we just had a little spat.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Look on the bright side. As the result of Penny's forfeit, you have become the world's first winner of Research Lab. Would you like a commemorative snow cone?
